title: Everest Base Camp Trek
priceNote: Estimated starting price per person based on double occupancy
accommodation: Hotel in Kathmandu and teahouses on trek
meals: Full board on trek; breakfast in Kathmandu
overview: Everest Base Camp Trek is one of Nepal's most famous trekking journeys. It takes travelers through Sherpa villages, Buddhist monasteries, suspension bridges, Sagarmatha National Park, Namche Bazaar, Tengboche, Dingboche, Lobuche, Gorakshep, Everest Base Camp, and Kala Patthar.
highlights: Scenic mountain flight to Lukla Explore Namche Bazaar and local Sherpa culture Visit the sacred Tengboche Monastery in the clouds Hike through Sagarmatha National Park Stand at the foot of Mount Everest at Base Camp (5,364m) Breathtaking sunrise panoramic view from Kala Patthar (5,545m)
costIncludes: Airport pickup and drop-off in Kathmandu Hotel stay with breakfast in Kathmandu Domestic flights Kathmandu-Lukla-Kathmandu Trekking permits Licensed guide and porters Teahouse accommodation during trek Meals on trek Standard first aid kit
costExcludes: International flights and visas Emergency rescue evacuation insurance Personal items, hot shower, charging, drinks Tips for guide and porter
requiredPermits: Sagarmatha National Park Permit Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Permit

faqs.q: What is the best month for this trek?
faqs.a: March to May and September to November offer clear skies, stable weather, and excellent mountain views.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is the Everest Base Camp Trek?
faqs.a: It is challenging. You should be in good physical health and capable of walking 5-7 hours daily with a light daypack.

faqs.q: Are there charging facilities along the trail?
faqs.a: Yes, teahouses offer device charging for a small fee ranging from $2 to $5 USD per device.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu and transfer to hotel
itinerary.desc: Welcome to Kathmandu. Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, you will be met by our representative and transferred to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Fly to Lukla and trek to Phakding
itinerary.desc: Take an early morning scenic flight to Hillary-Tenzing airport in Lukla (2,860m). Begin trekking to Phakding village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Cross suspension bridges, enter Sagarmatha National Park, and make a steep final climb to Namche Bazaar (3,440m).

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Rest day. Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Tengboche
itinerary.desc: Trek along ridge trails, descend to the river, and climb to Tengboche Monastery (3,860m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Walk past Mani stone walls, entering the dry Imja Valley to reach Dingboche (4,410m).

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Hike to Nangkartshang Peak (5,100m) for views of Makalu and Cho Oyu.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche
itinerary.desc: Walk past Thokla Pass climbers' memorial and follow the lateral moraine of the Khumbu Glacier to Lobuche (4,910m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Lobuche to Everest Base Camp and return to Gorakshep
itinerary.desc: Trek to Gorakshep (5,160m), then make the roundtrip hike to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) alongside the Khumbu Icefall.

itinerary.title: Hike to Kala Patthar and trek to Pheriche
itinerary.desc: Climb Kala Patthar (5,545m) at dawn for the finest sunrise view of Mt. Everest, Nuptse, and Lhotse, then descend to Pheriche (4,240m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Pheriche to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Retrace your steps down the valley, passing Pangboche and Tengboche before climbing back up to Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Lukla
itinerary.desc: Final day on the trail. Descend along the Dudh Koshi River and celebrate the journey in Lukla.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Take the morning scenic flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to hotel for rest.

itinerary.title: Final departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to airport for your flight back home.

title: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
priceNote: Estimated starting price per person based on standard teahouse package
accommodation: Hotel in Pokhara and teahouse lodges during trek

overview: Annapurna Base Camp Trek is a beautiful Himalayan journey through Gurung villages, dense rhododendron forests, terraced fields, natural hot springs, and the Annapurna Sanctuary.
highlights: Explore lakeside city of Pokhara
Witness traditional Gurung and Magar village life
Hike through lush rhododendron and bamboo forests
Relax in natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda
Visit Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m)
Stand inside the Annapurna Sanctuary amphitheater at ABC (4,130m)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Transfer to your hotel. Meet the group and review itinerary.

itinerary.title: Drive or fly to Pokhara

itinerary.title: Drive to Nayapul and trek to Ghandruk
itinerary.desc: Drive to Nayapul and begin hiking up to the beautiful Gurung village of Ghandruk (1,940m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Ghandruk to Chhomrong
itinerary.desc: Hike past terraced fields, descending to the river before climbing to Chhomrong (2,170m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Chhomrong to Bamboo
itinerary.desc: Descend Chhomrong stone steps, cross the bridge, and climb through oak forests to Bamboo (2,310m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Bamboo to Deurali
itinerary.desc: Hike past Hinku Cave, ascending through wet forests to Deurali (3,230m).

itinerary.title: Trek to Annapurna Base Camp via MBC
itinerary.desc: Pass Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), entering the sanctuary. Continue to Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Annapurna Base Camp to Bamboo
itinerary.desc: Enjoy sunrise over Annapurna peaks, then make a long descent back to Bamboo.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bamboo to Jhinu Danda
itinerary.desc: Hike past Chhomrong and descend to Jhinu Danda. Relax in natural hot springs.

itinerary.title: Trek to Siwai and drive to Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Walk to Siwai bridge, then board a private jeep back to Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Return to Kathmandu or final departure
itinerary.desc: Drive back to Kathmandu or proceed with departures.

faqs.q: What is the highest altitude reached?
faqs.a: The highest point is Annapurna Base Camp itself, located at 4,130 meters (13,550 feet).

faqs.q: Are there hot showers available?
faqs.a: Yes, most teahouses have hot showers for a small fee, except at the very highest elevations where buckets of hot water are provided.

title: Annapurna Circuit Trek
priceNote: Estimated starting price per person based on 14 days itinerary
accommodation: Standard Kathmandu/Pokhara hotels and teahouses during trek
meals: Breakfast in cities; 3 meals daily on trek
overview: Annapurna Circuit Trek is a classic Himalayan route crossing the famous Thorong La Pass. It passes through sub-tropical valleys, pine forests of Manang, high mountain landscapes, Muktinath pilgrim site, and the deep Kali Gandaki valley.
highlights: Staggering landscape diversity from rice terraces to start mountain pass
Explore the traditional Buddhist culture of Manang village
Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m), the highest pass on the circuit
Visit the sacred multi-tap temple of Muktinath
Drive through the Kali Gandaki river gorge (world's deepest)
Close-up views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Dhaulagiri ranges

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Transfer to your hotel. Meet your guide.

itinerary.title: Drive to Besisahar or Dharapani
itinerary.desc: Take a long, adventurous local drive along the Marsyangdi River to Dharapani village (1,860m).

itinerary.title: Trek to Chame
itinerary.desc: Hike through pine forests and climb past waterfalls to reach Chame (2,670m).

itinerary.title: Trek to Pisang
itinerary.desc: Walk below the massive curving rock face of Paungda Danda to Upper Pisang village (3,300m).

itinerary.title: Trek to Manang
itinerary.desc: Trek through upper dry meadows of Manang (3,540m).

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Manang
itinerary.desc: Rest day. Hike to Ice Lake (4,600m) or Gangapurna Glacier Lake.

itinerary.title: Trek to Yak Kharka
itinerary.desc: Leave the main river basin and walk to the alpine pastures of Yak Kharka (4,018m).

itinerary.title: Trek to Thorong Phedi or High Camp
itinerary.desc: Hike to the foot of Thorong La Pass at Thorong Phedi (4,450m). Rest early.

itinerary.title: Cross Thorong La Pass and trek to Muktinath
itinerary.desc: Climb steeply to Thorong La Pass (5,416m). Descend 1,600m to Muktinath (3,760m).

itinerary.title: Trek or drive to Jomsom
itinerary.desc: Trek through the windy, desert-like terrain of the Mustang valley to Jomsom (2,720m).

itinerary.title: Drive or fly to Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Take a morning flight or local vehicle down to Pokhara (820m).

itinerary.title: Rest day in Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Enjoy a free day by Phewa Lake.

itinerary.title: Return to Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Take the tourist bus back to Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Final departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to the airport for your international flight.

costIncludes: Airport transfers and city hotel stay
ACAP permit and TIMS card registration

faqs.q: How difficult is Thorong La Pass?
faqs.a: It is demanding. High altitudes (5,416m) and freezing dawn temperatures make it the most challenging day of the trek.

Hike past towering red clay cliffs and sky caves
Experience the unique rain-shadow desert landscape

itinerary.title: Trek Kagbeni to Chele
itinerary.desc: Enter the restricted area and follow the Kali Gandaki river to Chele (3,050m).

overview: Mera Peak (6,476m) is the highest official trekking peak in Nepal. Located in the beautiful Hinku Valley, it offers a non-technical glacier walk to the summit ridge. The view from the top is unparalleled, displaying five of the world's 8,000m peaks: Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, and Kanchenjunga.

Non-technical glacier climb suitable for fit beginners
